red: 1/9 failure: hash helper rewrites same inode after hashing, old SHA incorrectly accepted with new metadata
fix: Compare fstat device/inode/size/mtime_ns/ctime_ns before hashing, after hashing and after ZIP metadata inspection. Mutation returns WHEEL_ARTIFACT_CHANGED_DURING_INSPECTION without second full wheel hash.
lesson: An open descriptor fixes object identity across renames but does not freeze mutable contents. Bind hash and metadata to a stable observed file state.
limits: Observation-time only; final offline install must still verify expected hash. No promise against later writes, no rights/target/hardware/lock upgrade.
